function.name: pde_case_create
function.description: Create controlled synthetic demo, charge 5 initial experiments. No real industrial data. Fixtures: decay, diffusion, hyperdiffusion, advection_diffusion, reaction_diffusion, burgers. Budget5..9; noise0..0.03; seed0..800. Policies fixed_rich/random/ensemble_variance/structural_disagreement. Preserve returned case_id. Supply a stable request_id for retries: same configuration returns the same case without charging twice; a changed configuration is rejected.

function.name: case_status
function.description: Read case state, budget, candidate supports and evidence conflicts; never exposes hidden truth before validation.

function.name: asset_ingest
function.description: Register 1..10 text or CSV evidence documents, each with title,kind,text. Parse text/CSV before agent dispatch, retain originals, quarantine malformed tables, deduplicate content and return prioritized issues. Uploaded CSV is never numerical training input. Returns source IDs. Frozen evidence cannot change.

function.name: asset_context
function.description: Get a bounded prepared context packet for a named role: priority issues, source catalog and paginated graph fact candidates with exact citation/alias lineage. No full document bodies; numerical roles never receive raw CSV as training data. Role labels are filters, not authentication. Resolve P0 issues before dispatch.

function.name: asset_search
function.description: Lexical BM25 with Chinese bigrams and explicit bilingual aliases. Returns source ID, exact character offsets, line, quote and matched tokens. No embedding retrieval or semantic verification.

function.name: graph_propose
function.description: Propose source-backed facts: subject,predicate,object,source_id,quote. Fact must match a parsed source record with explicit alias lineage, or literal subject/object evidence. Unknown relations await operator review; spans do not prove semantic truth.

function.name: graph_apply
function.description: Apply verified source spans using known predicates, retaining conflicting facts. Unknown ontology relations cannot be self-approved by an agent.

function.name: evidence_path
function.description: Trace bounded directed paths through applied evidence facts across documents. Every edge retains its source and quote. Returns conflicts and assertion status, never invents causal facts; no path is not proof of absence.

function.name: case_handoff
function.description: Return structured handoff: current phase, state hash, remaining budget, next role/tool/arguments, required inputs, evidence blockers and stop flag. Never overrides actual tool guards or authenticates role identity. Stop on manual review, pending execution or terminal state.

function.name: pde_identify
function.description: Run existing multi-trajectory sparse identification with development-only selection. Returns model or explicit rejection. Bootstrap frequency is not calibrated probability. Forbidden after freeze.

function.name: experiment_propose
function.description: Choose next legal initial condition with configured policy and remaining budget. Returns proposal_id, cost and selection diagnostics. No physical equipment instruction.

function.name: experiment_acquire
function.description: Execute proposed simulation once; charges before execution, including failures. Replay never acquires twice. On started/recovery_required stop and report uncertain operation; never silently retry.

function.name: validation_freeze
function.description: Freeze current model, source code, observations and evidence before final evaluation. Subsequent identification and evidence changes are forbidden.

function.name: validation_evaluate
function.description: Open final synthetic evaluation once, after freeze. Score exact structure, extras/missing terms, coefficient error and three prefix-conditioned forecasts. All failure slots retained; cached result on repeat.

function.name: evidence_get
function.description: Export case evidence, graph, report and hash-chain consistency. Hash chain is not independent authentication of historical execution or LLM roles.
